tagline: Local STIHL dealer, full workshop service
heroSubheading: We stock STIHL equipment, service what we sell, and help locals find the right tool.
aboutHtml:
We're the STIHL dealer in Balclutha. Andrew Allan runs the shop, and we stock the full range of STIHL equipment for outdoor work. Chainsaws, trimmers, hedge cutters, lawn mowers, and everything in between. Whether you're a farmer, contractor, or home owner, we help you find the right machine for what you're trying to do.

We service what we sell. When gear breaks down, bring it in and we'll get it running again. We carry genuine STIHL parts and our workshop can handle most jobs quickly.

Pop in and see us. We're open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5:30pm, and Saturday mornings from 8am. Have a yarn about what you need, and we'll help you find the right STIHL kit for the job.
servicesIntro: We service STIHL equipment, stock genuine parts, and handle repairs quickly.
